claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_creature_ends_turn_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Incendiary Cloud's core ongoing threat fires when a creature ends its turn inside the sphere. The surface has on_attached_turn_start but no on_attached_turn_end or on_creature_ends_turn_in_area variant on OngoingTrigger. Using on_attached_turn_start would fire at the wrong point in the turn and produce a misleading trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature must also make this save when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: automatic_directional_reposition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloud moves 10 feet away from the caster automatically at the start of each caster turn in a caster-chosen direction. The existing reposition_attachment atom models a caster spending an action to freely reposition an illusion within range, not autonomous directional drift triggered by on_caster_turn_start. A new variant or trigger+effect pairing is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The cloud moves 10 feet away from you in a direction you choose at the start of each of your turns.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: once_per_turn_save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell fires saves on three distinct triggers (cast, enter area, end-of-turn) but enforces that a creature makes the save at most once per turn regardless of how many triggers fire. No surface mechanism exists to express per-turn deduplication across multiple OngoingOperations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes this save only once per turn.
